title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Lease, Clock Uncertainty, and Monotonic Fencing Extension

new_primitives.LEASE_ID: Time-bounded liveness hint associated with an authority epoch.
new_primitives.CLOCK_SOURCE_SET: Declared time sources and uncertainty bounds used by the runtime.
new_primitives.LATEST_FENCE_TOKEN: Highest authority generation accepted by a protected shared-effect channel.
new_primitives.STALE_WRITER_REJECT_RECEIPT: Evidence that a command was rejected because its authority generation was older than the protected boundary state.

authority_rule: Wall-clock validity alone never proves uniqueness of current authority. Shared side effects require current monotonic fencing or an equivalent anti-stale mechanism enforced outside the proposing runtime.
verification_requirements: newer quorum epoch while old node remains isolated
external actuator rejects old fence token even when old local lease says valid
unknown-current-generation case fails closed for shared effects
canonical_lines: Time can bound waiting; it cannot by itself prove that no newer writer exists.
Authority order is logical before it is chronological.
The world boundary must reject yesterday's pen even if yesterday's clock still says today.
